name: anime-manager
description: Local anime management library with Bangumi metadata and mpv integration

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,tauri -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server:watch" "npm run dev:tauri"
scripts.dev:server:watch: nodemon -w server -w public --ignore server/anime-data.json --ignore server/config.json --ignore server/scanned-tree.json --ignore server/prisma/ --ignore server/covers/ --ignore server/thumbs/ server/server.js
scripts.build: npm run build:server && tauri build --bundles msi nsis
scripts.build:msi: npm run build:server && tauri build --bundles msi
scripts.build:nsis: npm run build:server && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.dev:prod: npm run build:server && powershell -Command "$p=Start-Process -NoNewWindow -PassThru node -ArgumentList 'server/server.js'; Start-Sleep 3; try { npx tauri dev } finally { $p | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.postinstall: cd server && npm ci --production && cd .. && prisma generate
